tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsang dpe bkra shis re skong bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis zla ba yar gyi ngo*// gza' skar dge ba'i nam seng la// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong sde brgyad ji snyed pa'i// gtor ma dang ni gser skyems bshams// phye mar chu gtsang nyer spyod lnga// dkar sna mngar sna khrag sna dang*// liṅga mchod pa'i rdzas su bkod// spos sman shing sna'i bsangs sbyar zhing// mda' dang 'phan mdzes mkha' la 'phyar// gnam la 'phur dang sa la rgyu'i// srog chags gzugs dang rin chen bdun// bkra shis rdzas sogs tsak+ka li// gtor ma'i thad kyi bar snang bsgrengs// bdag nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas ni// oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya warta ya ho badz+ra sarba s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod mgron rnams thams cad kyi// yid dga'i mchod rdzas mkha' khyab bsam// rnga sil gling bu dung sogs dang*// snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer// kyai/ ka dag ngos gzung bral ba'i dbyings// lhun grub ma 'gags 'char sgo'i dpyid// mnyam nyid thugs rje'i klong las su// bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas sku// cung zad khro ba'i nyams ldan par// dbu la pad zhwa rgod ldem gsol// za 'og ber dang chos gos bzhes// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni phrag g.yon bkal// rgyal po chen po'i rol pas bzhugs// g.yas su lha lcam man+dha ra// sngo sangs grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma// g.yon du mkhar chen mtsho rgyal bza'// dkar mo gnyis ka'ang bdud rtsi 'bul// sku gsung thugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐// de las spyan 'dren 'od zer 'phros// kyai/ 'di nas nyi ma lho nub mtshams// rnga yab gling gi yul gyi dbus// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtse'i// pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas// srin po khrims la 'god pa'i rgyal// pad+ma thod phreng rtsal yab yum// 'khor du dpal bo mkha' 'gros bskor// 'ja' dang 'od du pu ru ru// dad pas spyan 'dren tshur gshegs la// gnas mchog 'di ru byin cig phob// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang zhig bskur// mthun rdzas rnams la nus pa bskyed// kyai/

rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs kyi rje// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus kyi mgon// ma mo mkha' 'gro rol pa'i yab// pad+ma 'byung gnas khyod la bstod// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod rdzas ci mchis kun tu bzang*// mchod pa'i sprin las gang sprul pa// de bzhin bdag gis 'bul gyis bzhes// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// bcas rang kha na ma tho'i sdig /bgyis dang 'gyid rtsal yi rangs ba// thams cad khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags// dge ba byed la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// dge ba byang chub thob phyir bsngo// 'khor bcas bdag dang gnyis med gyur// dzaḥdzaḥ'agugs byed lcags kyu 'phros// kyai/ kun bzang thugs rjer rol pa'i tshe// kun khyab bla ma rin po che// brtan g.yo'i rnam 'phrul mi zad pas// byin rlabs ya mtshan 'gyed par mdzad// khams drug dag pa'i snang brnyan la// zhi ba dang ni khro chags kyi// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun shar nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// 'byung lnga'i zad pa gzhom med sgra// gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags dang*// snying po'i chos phung skal ba bzhin// rang rang so so'i skad du grags// nā ḍi dbu mar rengs pa'i gzugs// sa gsum rol pa'i tshogs kyi mchog /mkha' gro ma yi drwa ba sdom// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel// skyabs kyi dam pa khyed rnams la// gnyis su med par su skyabs pa// de ni stobs chen bdud bzhi'i g.yul// mnyam nyid rig pa'i ngang du 'joms// de phyir deng nas khyed rnams la// mi phyed blo yis bdag skyab kyis// bden min rdzun min chu zla'i dpes// mtshon pa'i rol pas 'dir gshegs shig /kyai/ dkon mchog gsum po 'dus pa'i dpyid// rdo rje srin po khro bo'i rgyal// mahā kā la phyag bzhi pa// sprul pa'i zhing skyong chen por snang*// khrag 'thung chen po'i tshogs kyi rje// 'jigs byed khro bo spro ba'i gzhi// sbyor ba'i yum ni tsan+ḍi ka

/sngags bdag chen mo ral gcig ma// 'dod pa khams la dbang sgyur tshe// dpal ldan dud sol lha mor grags// dung skyong re ti mched bzhi dang*// dmag zor rang byung rgyal mo sogs// dbyings gyi ma mo cir yang rdzu// 'gugs byed gsod byed sgrol byed dang*// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// las dang phra men sgo skyong bzhi// srid pa'i ma mo yongs kyis bskor// 'khril ba'i yum ni mkha' 'gro drug /gdong can brgyad po dag kyang 'phrul// yid la 'dod pa rnams ster la// bkra shis tshe ring mched lngar snang*// dam tshig can gyi mgon skyabs la// bod yul lhan cig skyes ma ste// rdo rje g.yu sgron mar yang grags// bod khams dkar po skyong ba la// bstan ma bcu gnyis dag tu shar// dpal gyi lha mo ro zan ma// rdo rje snang yon rab brtan dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi mo rgyud kun// de yi bka' sdod pho nya mo// dpal ldan mgon po'i blon po ni// legs ldan nag po chen po ste// bya rog gdong can 'jig par ston// mched ni gsum bcas gsang ba'i bu// de ni lha dmag dbugs 'byin la// gri gug rje blon 'bangs su mdzad// phas kyi dmag dpung 'joms pa la// bing chen thogs pa sprul pa yin// mu stegs sngags bzlog mkhan gyi gshed// ma ning nag po cher yang snang*// gzhan yang gur gyi mgon po dang*// phyag drug pa dang a gho ra// rje btsan seng ge stag zhon dang*// srog tig trak+shad ber nag gyon// sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ni// yon tan phrin las mgon po'i rigs// sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges pa// cir yang rdzu 'phrul stobs las 'gyed// las mdzad mgon po zhal bzhi pa// zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong par bstan// ma he khros pa'i mgo yang 'gar// sing na ra ma dang ni rol// dus mtshan srin po pho nyar bskul// sde brgyad dam tshogs dgra la spro// khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// 'jigs byed dregs pa'i dpon du bskos// klu srin gdong mo gza' chen brgyad// skar ma'i lha ni de yi bran*// dgra bo'i srog la rngam zas byed// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// khros pa gnod sbyin khrag ral can// nor rgyun ma dang rtag tu sbyor// rta bdag yum bcas brgyad la sogs// gos sngon can ni thams cad 'khor// ser chags yongs kyi dgra lha ste// lho phyogs dur khrod tsā ri tra'i// gshin rje'i rgyal po yum dang ni// gshed bzhi gshin rje'i pho nya rnams// dam nyams gsod pa'i gshan par bsngags// kyai/

rgyal po sku lnga yum chen lnga*// blo po lnga dang sprul pa lnga// las mkhan gnod sbyin rtse mar// 'khor gyi ru 'dren sde bzhir bcas// sgrol ging chen por byin gyis brlabs// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang*// dregs pa bco brgyad bka' la nyan// ro langs brgya dang nag po stong*// sha za 'bum dang ma mo'i sde// sa ya gnod sbyin khri dang ni// gtsang rigs mgon po bdun cu lnga// pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// 'jigs byed dgu dang sring mo bzhi// ma mo chen mo bdun rnams dang*// 'bar ma brgyad rnams bka' sdod lags// bse mkhar gnas pa'i ma ru rtse// beg rtse ming sring gshan pas bskor// shān ta pu rir gnas pa yi// tshogs bdag glang po'i gdong pa can// skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs// mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i gtso// de wi ko ṭi la dga' ba'i// snyon kha'i rje btsan btsan rgod che// jag pa me len la sogs pa// phyi nang gsang ba sbas pa dang*// bstan srung drag po sngags dang ni// rtags shing chags dang las byed pa'i// lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'khor// de lta'i chos skyong chen po khyod// sprul pa yang sprul las mkhan bcas// rdo rje'i gdan du rtag par gnas// bsil ba'i tshal du pho brang btab// dur khrod chen po brgyad du rol// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing na dgyes// 'jig rten khams rnams mtshan mo nyul// nang pa rnams kyi dgra lha ste// phyi pa rnams kyi gshed ma yin// dam pa'i gtsug lag ma lus skyong*// dam tshig can gyi slad bzhin 'brang*// mna' zan kun gyi srog dbugs 'gams// zhing bcu tshang ba'i snying khrag 'jib// nag po'i phyogs rnams rlag par byed// phas kyi brtsams pa'i las rnams 'joms// dam can rgya mtsho khyed thams cad// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// mthun pa'i rdzas la spyan 'dren gyis// ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol// kyai/

mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo nas// dma' ba mnar med lcags kyi gzhi'i// bar du gnas pa 'byon 'os shing*// khom pa ming du ma 'tshal ba// thams cad kyang ni 'bod lags so// sa bdag rje blon bcu bzhi dang*// lo zla zhag tshes dus dag la// phan gnod dbang byed thams cad dang*// pu rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams kyi// srid pa'i lha rabs mched dgu dang*// rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum dang*// 'bangs kyi srog lha bcu gnyis sogs// lha srin gnyan po thams cad dang*// dpal gyi lha sa bsam yas sogs// chos gzhi ji snyed skyong rnams dang*// khyad par gang ba bzang po dang*// mi sngon rta ston sgo bdud pa// jo bo rtse bo rags ma'i btsan// de dag la sogs dkar rgyud kyi// gdan sa dben gnas srung rnams dang*// khyad par yul khams 'di nyid kyi// yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad sogs// pho lha dgra lha zhang lha dang*// mo lha yul lha la sogs pa'i// mgon skyabs stongs grogs byed pa'i lha// thams cad ma lus 'dir gshegs shig /kyai/ pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu'i steng*// rin chen rnam pa lnga brtsigs pa// phyi nang thams cad sa le ba// 'dzam bu gser gyi ba gam bskor// g.yu yi gdung nas mu tig gi /dra ba dra phyed mdzes par sbrel// phyi rol 'phyar ba'i mar gad kyi// bya 'dab dngul gyi shar bus brgyan// steng du zla shel pu shu la// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs// mdzes pa'i rgyan cha kun gyis spras// rgya phubs 'phar ma bdun brtsegs la// phra ma khod snyoms bar du snang*// phyi nang logs ni dbang po'i gzhus// ci dgu ri mo'i gzugs su bris// mthil ni gser gyi mig mangs ris// bai ḍūr+ya yi mthing zhal can// nor bu'i bla bre phub pa'i 'og /rin chen khri gdan yid 'ong la// dkon mchog srid zhu mgron rnams dang*// zhi ba'i las la dgyes rnams bzhugs// kyai/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong*// ma traṃ ru tra bsgral ba'i gzhir// gnam lcags zhun dang khrag zhag gis// thod pa skam rlon brtsegs pa'i mkhar// steng du zhing gi thog phub pa// logs su rgyu rlon mkhal ma snying*// nang khrol mgo bo'i 'phreng bas brgyan// khrag zhal klad pa 'khrug pa'i mtsho'i// bam chen keng rus brtsigs pa'i khrir// mgon po yon tan mgron la sogs// mngon spyod las la dgyes rnams bzhugs// kyai/

byin rlabs rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub 'byung ba'i yi dam lha// 'phrin las mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro dang*// bar chad srung ba'i dam can dang*// mgon skyabs stongs grogs byed pa'i lha// bstod 'os kun la phyag bgyi'o// kyai/ 'jig rten pa dang mthun 'jug phyir// byin gyis brlabs pa spos kyi chu// dkar sna 'o ma dmar sna'i khrag /sku gsung thugs la khrus su 'bul// kyai/ dbyibs mdzes mdangs mtshar man+da ra// dbu la bcing pa'i thod du bshams// tsan dan spos dkar a ka ru// nag po bsregs pa snom par sbyar// brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu'i byin// mun sel mar me gzigs mor che// bsam gtan lha yi dag byed chab// thugs la sim pa skyed pa'i skyems// ro brgya ldan pa mtho ris zas// ljags kyis myang ba'i dpal du lhags// rnga sil gling bu pi wang gi /sgra snyan glu bcas snyan la 'jebs// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ma'i// lha mo bzhin mdzes gar gyis rol// 'khor lo nor bu rta glang blon// btsun mo dmag dpon mdun du 'gying*// bkra shis rdzas thogs bu mo brgyad// sgeg cing snyems pas lang tsho ngom// rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs lhab lhub// 'phyar dar rlung g.yob phye phur rnams// mchod pa'i sprin du de ring 'bul// bdag gi bsam don 'grub par shog /kyai/ sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs gzugs brnyan la// sku yi rdo rje zhes su btags// gzhom med skad ni thams cad pa// gsung gi rdo rje nyid du gzhag /lhan skyes rnam pa ma lus pa// thugs kyi rdo rjer 'tshal ba'i phyir// de ni 'gro ba'i khams rjes 'brang*// nam mkha'i pha mthas mtshon pa tsam// gzhan pas gsang ba bsnyad mi bzod// de phyir bsam mi khyab pa nyid// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin te// rang gi sems dang gnyis min par// bzhugs kyang dman pas ma rnyed par// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang chos skyong che// 'jig rten pa zhes rigs su 'byed// blo gros chen po de dag ni// gcig dang tha dad gar mi 'dzin// bstod bya stod byed bstod pa rnams// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar// rang gi rig pa'i ye shes las// bstod pa'i dam pa gang na mchis// 'on kyang ma brtags nyams dga' ba'i// kun rdzob tsam du bdag gis ni// mi mthun rkyen rnams 'joms pa dang*// nas sel gdon rlag sdig pa zhi// sgrib sbyong byed la mthu stobs ni// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i phung po 'dra// gang gi tshe dpal bsod nams dang*// stobs dang mnga' thang ji snyed pa// ches cher rgyas par mdzad pa la// yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po yin// srid pa'i khams kyi dbang po che// skyes pa bud med longs spyod dang*// kha zas yid 'ong thams cad ni// 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu byed par mthong*// bstan pa 'jig byed dgra bgegs rnams// bsad dbye bskrad mnan bcing dang rengs// mngon spyod drag po'i las rnams la// rno ba'i ral gri lag par 'khums// de dag cha shas tsam zhig ste// gzhan du yon tan kun brjod na// srid pa nyid du'ang mi zad pas// zab dang shin tu rgya che'o// kyai/

sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso bo bden pa'i mchog /dam chos 'dod chags bral ba bden pa'i mchog /dge 'dun tshogs kyi zhing ste bden pa'i mchog /bden pa'i mchog ni rnam gsum nus mthu yis// dag byed bsang dang gser skyems gtor ma dang*// dgyes pa'i brngan ni mgron rnams thams cad la// rang rang 'dod pa bzhin du 'byung gyur cig /kyai/ dkyil 'khor bzhi yi nang bzhugs nas// gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib gtor byed// dga' bzhi'i ye shes blugs pa las// lhag pa'i dag byed ga la dgos// 'on kyang nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma// sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma ste// chu khams rdo rje ma ma ki /me khams rdo rje gos dkar mo// rlung khams dam tshig sgrol ma ste// yum lnga 'dus nas byin brlabs pas// yul zhig chags pa sman gyi yul// grong zhig chags pa blta na sdug /ri zhig chags pa sman gyi ri// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i snying po 'khrungs// de dag grib sel bsangs su byas// dri zhim ngad pas nad kyi rigs// stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sel// me lce 'od du 'bar ba yis// nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong 'joms// dud pa mkha' la chags pa yis// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong mtshon// kyai/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// srid pa'i mes po tshangs pa des// dag byed 'bar ba'i me la byas// 'dod dgu thams cad de las byung*// de nas bar gyi bskal pa la// dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe// lha srin gnyan po rgyud 'khrugs nas// nyin mo brtsigs pa nub mo bshig /dge ba'i las brtsams mthar ma phyin// de dus gdug pa 'dul slad du// rje blon 'bangs rnams gros byas nas// rgyal sras pad+ma spyan drangs byon// slob dpon chen po thabs mkhas pas// bsangs dang gser skyems gtor ma dang*// dgyes pa'i brngan ni ci yang mdzad// phal cher de yis gnod sems zhi// ha cang mi bsrun nus pas btul// kyai/

da lta bskal pa'i mtha' ma la// lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kyi// 'khon 'dzin phrag dog sel ba'i thabs// gtsang btsog ngan pa sel ba'i thabs// rkyen ngan bar chad sel ba'i thabs// srung ma las la bskul ba'i thabs// khang khyim mi gtsang sel ba'i thabs// tshe srog sra zhing brtan pa'i thabs// gza' skar ngan pa sel ba'i thabs// gzhi dang gnas la sdod pa'i tshe// mthun rkyen 'byor pa spel ba'i thabs// thag ring byes su 'gro ba'i tshe// don rnams thams cad 'grub pa'i thabs// de ring bsangs kyi mchod pa 'bul// kyai/ bdud rtsi can shing dud pas bsangs// gser lo 'bar ba'i stag pas bsangs// g.yu lo 'bar ba'i smyug mas bsangs// dung lo 'bar ba'i ba lus bsangs// 'chong lo 'bar ba'i su lus bsangs// a shu shug pa'i dud pas bsangs// dri bzang spos dkar dud pas bsangs// a ru ra yi dud pas bsangs// ma nu ru rta'i dud pas bsangs// spos me dri zhim dud pas bsangs// nam mkha'i snying po g.yu yis bsangs// ri rab snying po mchong gis bsangs// rgya mtsho'i snying po dung gis bsangs// sa yi snying po gser gyis bsangs// shing thog snying po mngar gyis bsangs// 'bru yi snying po chang gis bsangs// phur mo gla rtsi tsher shing dang*// phye mar 'o skom dri bzang dang*// spos dang sha chang phud kyis bsangs// kyai/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nas// rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar// bde gshegs sprul pa 'ba' zhig pa'i// brgyud pa bzhin ldan bla ma bsangs// bde dgyes dus 'khor gsang 'dus sogs// bla med rnal 'byor spyod pa dang*// bya ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa yi// yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// 'jam dpal pad+ma yang dag dang*// bdud rtsi phur pa ma mo dang*// 'jig rten dmod pa drag sngags te// bsgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad bsangs// zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang*// khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sogs// theg pa rim dgur bshad pa yi// gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha kun bsangs// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// gnas gsum spyod pa'i ḍā ki? ma// tshogs kyi mchog rnams thams cad bsangs// bya rog ming can yab yum dang*// gsang ba'i bu bzhi las mdzad gsum// gdong can brgyad dang ro langs brgya// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mos ya gnod sbyin khri// rgyal po bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu// lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad// gnod sbyin brgyad dang gza' chen brgyad// rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'jigs byed dgu

/ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad// pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi bsangs// dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma// 'gugs byed gsod byed sgrol byed dang*// mkha' 'gro bzhi dang phra men brgyad// mkha' 'gro drug sogs srid pa yi// 'jig byed ma mo'i tshogs rnams bsangs// legs ldan gri gug trag shad dang*/ beng dang ma ning gur zhal dang*// phyag drug rta med rje btsan dang*// seng ge stag zhon ber nag gyon// srog tig mgon po rigs lnga bsangs// seng gdong yab yum bam ro gnyis// sde brgyad bdud dmag stong sde bsangs// khyab 'jug klu srin gdong mo bzhi// phyi nang gsang ba'i gza' skar bsangs// dpal ldan rgyal po ngal bsos bu// nor rgyun ma dang rta bdag brgyad// yum bcas gos sngon can rnams bsangs// dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po dang*// tsa mun+ḍi dang gshed po bzhi// 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya bsangs// chos kyi rgyal po sku lnga dang*// yum blon sprul lnga rtse ma ra// ru 'dren bcas pa thams cad bsangs// gzhan yang sde dpon sum cu dang*// dregs pa bco brgyad beg tse dang*// tshogs bdag rdo legs snyon kha dang*// jag pa me len la sogs pa'i// pho rgyud chos skyong srung ma bsangs// dung skyong re ti mched bzhi dang*// dmag zor ma dang rang byung rgyal// jo mo bkra shes tshe ring mched// rdo rje g.yu sgron dpal lha dang*// dur khrod bdag mo dpal ldan ma// bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs// srung ma mo brgyud thams cad bsangs// phyin nang gsang sbas bstan srung dang*// drag po sngags chags las byed pa'i// lha srin gnyan po thams cad bsangs// ming du ma 'tshal mgron kun dang*// phan gnod dbang byed sa bdag dang*// srid lha mgur lha srog lha sogs// bod kyi gzhi bdag thams cad bsangs// gang bzang mi sngon rta sngon dang*// rgo bdud jo bo rtse bo sogs// chos gzhi dben gnas srung rnams bsangs// kyai/

rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la// 'go zhing stong grogs byed pa yi// dgra lha gnyan po thams cad bsangs// mi la 'go ba'i dgra lha bsangs// wer ma ger ma tshogs 'khor bcas// lha gnyen rma chen spom ra bsangs// srid pa'i lha bdud dkar po bsangs// srid pa'i rdzi lung 'phyo ba bsangs// 'od zer me stag 'phro ba bsangs// srid pa chags pa'i dgra lha bsangs// smon pa 'grub pa'i dgra lha bsangs// gleng gzhi 'grub pa'i dgra lha bsangs// dpa' snying che ba'i dgra lha bsangs// myur zhing mgyogs pa'i dgra lha bsangs// 'go ba'i dgra lha spun gsum bsangs// mi thub dgra lha spun gsum bsangs// lta ba mig rno dgra lha bsangs// nyan pa rna gsang dgra lha bsangs// snom pa sna yi dgra lha bsangs// smra ba lce mgyogs dgra lha bsangs// dpa' rtsal che ba'i dgra lha bsangs// mgyogs pa rta yi dgra lha bsangs// sra ba ber gyi dgra lha bsangs// btsan po khrab kyi dgra lha bsangs// rno ba mtshon gyi dgra lha bsangs// stag gdong khra ba'i nang shed na// sgro smyug 'dzom pa'i dgra lha bsangs// gzigs shubs thig le'i nang gnas pa'i// rwa shing 'dzom pa'i dgra lha bsangs// kha 'dzin shags 'debs dgra lha bsangs// 'go ba'i lha lnga thams cad bsangs// skyob pa'i lha dgu thams cad bsangs// bar lha ri bo gnyan po bsangs// khyim gyi khyim lha gel thung bsangs// nor bdag 'dzam lha 'khor bcas bsangs// mkhar gyi rtse lha gnyan po bsangs// thabs lha de ni yu mo bsangs// thab sman de ni dkar mo bsangs// zhing lha de ni gnyan mchod bsangs// phyugs kyi nor lha gnyan po bsangs// sgo yi sgo lha stag g.yag bsangs// lam lha de ni 'gron bu bsangs// lam dang byes kyi lha gnyan bsangs// 'gro yang cang shes gnyan po bsangs// tshong lha 'phrul dgu thams cad bsangs// phyi rabs rgyud kyi dgra lha bsangs// dmu rabs rgyud kyi srung ma bsangs// gtsug rabs rgyud kyi srung ma bsangs// steng gi dgra lha dmu khri bsangs// sa yi dgra lha mtshan rtag bsangs// kha zas sprod pa'i dgra lha bsangs// lam nor sprod pa'i dgra lha bsangs// pha tshan yab lha gdal drug bsangs// ma tshan rgyal mo thing ge bsangs// gri tshan ltag tsha 'al 'ol bsangs// bsangs kyis mi bsangs gang yang med// ma bsangs pa rnams thams cad bsangs// ma dag pa rnams thams cad dag

/bsam pa sgrub la re ba skongs// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// kyai/ 'bru sna kun la grub pa'i chang*// rtsa brgyad stong dang gser phye sbyar// mtho ris bdud rtsi las lhag pa'i// zag pa med pa'i skyems su 'bul// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron rnams la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol// mahā kā la man chad nas// bdud mgon trag shad yan chad kyi// pha gcig mgon po thams cad la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// srid gsum bdag mo man chad nas// nam gru ma ning yan chad kyi// ma gcig lha mo thams cad la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas 'phrin las sgrub tu gsol// bya rog gdong can man chad nas// las byed lha srin sde brgyad bar// dam can chos skyong thams cad la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// zhing skyong pho nya man chad nas// yul phyogs 'di yi lha yan gyi// gnas bdag gzhi bdag thams cad la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas ru nga ma mdzad cig /srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// mnar med lcags khang yan chad kyi// 'gro drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas gnod sems ma mdzad cig /bgegs dang log 'dren man chad nas// blo bur ye 'brog yan chad kyi// lan chags bdag po thams cad la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas phyin chad gnod ma byed// kyai/ nam mkha' las ni dpangs mtho zhing*// sa gzhi'i khyon las rgya che la// rgya mtsho'i klong las gting zab ste// nyi zla gnyis las cher gsal ba// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// so so'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis// rang rang yid bzhin thob gyur cig

/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dharmā ṇaṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi// snying la lcags kyu can gyis btab// ske nas zhags pa can gyis bcings// yan lag lcags sgrog can gyis bsdams// rgyab nas dril bu can gyis mnyed// gshin rje'i mtshon khang 'bar ba bsgyel// mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phrol// yungs kar rgyal po'i thun gyis brabs// rdo rje phur pa snying la btab// rno ngar 'dzom pa'i ral gris gtubs// tho bas klad nas cham chem bzos// gtun shing bsnun pas rus pa gnyags// sha khrag rus pa thams cad ni// mchog dang dman par rnam lngar phye// mchog ni srid zhu'i mgron rnams kyi// zhal du btab po kha raṃ khā hi// bar ma pho brgyud mo brgyud kyi// zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā hi// de 'og las byed pho nya che'i// zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā hi// gzhan ni snying rje'i mgron rnams kyi// zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā hi// lhag ma lan chags mgron rnams kyi// zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā hi// kyai/ snang tshad sku la grags tshad gsung*// dran tshad thugs su rang rig pa'i// khyab gdal mos gus chen po 'dis// rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad brngan// rtsa ni yon po rlung gis bsangs// rlung ni log pa mal du sad// dwangs mas dbu ma'i mas bskyang pas// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum brngan// tshul khrims shin tu dag par bsrungs// dam pa'i chos la thos bsam byas// ma nor thar pa'i lam bsgoms pas// ye shes mgon po lcam dral brngan// g.yag lug dom dred stag gzig spyang*// dpa' bo bsgral ba'i tsit+ta'i nang*// srog 'khor stem dang bla rdo'i mkhar// las mdzad mgon po gsang ba'i brngan// 'bru sna nag po khrag la sbrus// zur gsum dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras// 'bras bu rin chen rnams kyis klubs// lhun chags gtor ma nang gis brngan// rwa rno rmig pa rdo rje gzi// kha rlangs me yi tsha tsha 'phro// spu gzhol char sprin gnyer 'dra ba'i// g.yal lug nag po phyi yi brngan// seng ge stag gzig dom dred dang*// phag rgod ce spyang 'phar ba dang*// khyi nag dug gi mche ba can// rol du khrid par byed pa'i brngan// gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder la// mtshon cha ngar ma'i gshog pa can// khyung nag bya rog kaṅka sogs// bya khyi klad la lding ba'i brngan// sna tshogs mdangs kyis yid 'ong ba'i// rma bya nor bu'i mdongs sgro can// 'dab chags bya yi gar mkhan kun// spyan gyi gzigs mo skyod pa'i brngan// gdung ba'i mchi mas mig gang zhing*// 'bad pa'i dbyangs brda lhang lhang grags// mthun rdzas ma tshang med bdar ba// mo brgyud srung ma rnams kyi brngan// sha sna snying sna khrag sna dang*// klad zhag gsur chen zhun gyi sgron// rkang gling thod rnga rnge'u chung sgra*// lha srin drag po dgyes pa'i brngan// dkar gsum mngar gsum sman sna dang// 'bru tshogs rin chen shing gi 'bras// dar zab mkho dgu'i yo byad ni// sa bdag lha klu sman sogs brngan// dpa' bo zhub can stag chas btags// ral gri 'phyar zhing ru mtshon bsgrengs// gtum pa'i ngar skad glu ru len// 'di ni dgra lha'i rgyal po'i brngan// 'thab shes glang chen mgyogs pa'i rta// dre'u dang bong bu rnga mong dang*// chu glang ma he la sogs pa'i// dgra la rgyug byed bzhon pa'i brngan// kyai/

yul gyi ming ni gdong dmar bod// dkar po skyong ba'i bstan ma ni// rdo rje kun bzang kun grags ma// ya ma skyong dang bgegs kyi gtso// spyan gcig klu mo dpal gyi yum// grags mo rgyal dang bod khams skyong*// sman gcig zu le g.yar mo bsil// re re'ang 'khor ni sman btsun 'bum// yul lha ci yang mdun du bdar// gtor ma gser skyems rin chen lnga// dar zab mkho dgu kun gyi brngan// kyai/ mi gtsang zas su zos pa bsangs// mi gtsang gos su gyon pa bsangs// dam grib btsog grib gshan grib bsangs// bag grib yugs grib mdze grib bsangs// thab shor gzhob shor bsnol shor bsangs// nyams grib skyon rnams thams cad bsangs// lha dang mi la grib phog cing*// sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba rnams// bsangs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'dis// thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig /kyai/ da ni 'dod pa'i don gsol ba// deng nas bdag gi kha 'dzin mdzod// mtho ba'i sa nas bya ra mdzod// dma' ba'i sa nas mel tshe mdzod// mun pa'i nang du sgron me spor// dgra dpung shigs la bdud dpung chom// bsam pa sgrub la re ba skong*// tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod// kyai/ phan tshun cig gis gcig bstod na// ha bo yi ni gangs bas dkar// phan tshun gcig gis gcig smad na// rong po yi ni rdza bas nag /de bas gcig gis gcig bstod 'tshal// de bas che ba'i che brjod 'tshal// de bas gnyan pa'i bsnyen bkur 'tshal// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// ku re kyal kha mas mdzad cig /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /sa la nga yin ma zer cig /yul la nga yin ma zer cig /spyan gyi gzer mig ma ldog cig /shang gi dung sna ma bud cig /zhi gyur byang sems ldan gyur cig /kyai/ gshegs so gshegs so rten la gshegs// srid zhu mgron rnams sangs rgyas yul// sku dang ye shes ngang du gshegs// mgon po yon tan mgron rnams ni// mchog gi sprul sku'i zhing du gshegs// 'gro drug snying rje'i mgron rnams ni// srid pa gsum gyi gnas su byon// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba'i mgron// rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/// /
